conflicts.rationale: Table 2 on 7766299 is the per-event STRUCTURE table and is the more specific source for what a message may contain. The official golden sample spec-source/golden/HL7 v2.5.1/ADT/ADT_sample03.txt is an A03 and contains NO DG1 segment (MSH EVN PID PV1 AL1 AL1). A sample that omits DG1 cannot be reconciled with DG1 = R, so the sample and Table 2 agree against Table 1.
conflicts.resolution: Treat DG1 on A03 as OPTIONAL (O), repeatable. Do not raise an error when it is absent.

conflicts.resolution: Not a real contradiction. AL1 MAY be present in an A03 (structurally optional) but NPHIES discards it. Validator: accept AL1 in an A03, emit an informational note that it will be ignored; never error and never require it.

discrepancies.observedInSample: NO DiagnosticReport entry exists in either official Radiology Report bundle. The string "DiagnosticReport" does not occur anywhere in the files.
discrepancies.resolution: SAMPLE WINS. Do not raise an error when DiagnosticReport is missing from a Radiology Report bundle; downgrade to a warning and flag the rule as disputed.
discrepancies.rule: Bundle entry for Diagnostic Report - usage M [1..1] (page 414154754, "Radiology Results Report (structured)")
discrepancies.severity: high - would produce a false rejection on every conformant radiology report

discrepancies.observedInSample: The resource type in the sample is "Procedure" (referenced from the Composition "Current Imaging Procedure Descriptions" section). There is no FHIR resource type called "Imaging Procedure".
discrepancies.resolution: "Imaging Procedure" is the spec's label for a profiled FHIR Procedure resource. Validate resourceType == "Procedure".

discrepancies.observedInSample: The last entry is a DocumentReference, and there is no Binary entry.
discrepancies.resolution: SAMPLE WINS. Accept DocumentReference in an embedded-PDF Radiology Report bundle. Do not require Binary.
discrepancies.rule: The resource list on 414154754 names Binary R2 [0..*] for the embedded-PDF variant but never names DocumentReference.

discrepancies.observedInSample: Every uncontrolled-meds prescription sample contains an AllergyIntolerance entry between the Observation entries and the MedicationRequest entry.
discrepancies.resolution: SAMPLE WINS. Accept AllergyIntolerance in a non-Raqeeb Prescription Bundle; treat it as R2 [0..*] there too.
discrepancies.rule: The non-Raqeeb Prescription Bundle page (44171887) lists no AllergyIntolerance entry. Only the Raqeeb page (117964890) lists AllergyIntolerance R2 [0..*].
discrepancies.severity: medium - would produce a false "unexpected resource" finding

discrepancies.observedInSample: The sample contains 20 sections because "Procedure Description" (LOINC 29554-3, templateId 2.16.840.1.113883.3.3731.1.210.100.40) appears TWICE in a row at positions 11 and 12.
discrepancies.resolution: SPEC WINS here: this is a copy/paste defect in the sample, not a cardinality rule. The duplicated section has an identical code and templateId. Do not infer that Procedure Description repeats. Flag a duplicate as a warning, not an error.
discrepancies.rule: Table 21 on page 15925320 lists 19 sections for Operative Notes, each once, ending Care Plan, Postoperative Diagnosis, Planned Procedure, Procedure Disposition.
discrepancies.severity: low - documented so an analyst is not surprised by the sample

discrepancies.goldenSample: spec-source/golden/CDA/nphies Radiology Results Embedded PDF v4.9beta1.xml
discrepancies.observedInSample: The document has NO structuredBody and therefore ZERO sections; the payload is a nonXMLBody. Its document templateIds are 2.16.840.1.113883.3.3731.1.204.34 + 1.3.6.1.4.1.19376.1.2.20 (IHE XDS-SD).
discrepancies.resolution: The embedded-PDF variant is a scanned-document (XDS-SD) CDA. Do not apply the structured section-order rules to it.
discrepancies.rule: Section-order tables assume a structuredBody with component/section children.
discrepancies.severity: high - applying the structured rules would reject every embedded-PDF report

discrepancies.goldenSample: spec-source/golden/SOAP/ITI-18/1 nphies ITI18 RegistryStoredQueryResponse v4.9beta1 - Returns Discharge Summary DocumentEntry - Kopie.xml (and the "2 ..." response)
discrepancies.observedInSample: Both ITI-18 RESPONSE samples use a lower-case root element <soap:envelope>.
discrepancies.resolution: SPEC WINS. XML is case sensitive and the SOAP 1.2 schema defines "Envelope". This is a defect in the samples. Do not emit <soap:envelope>.
discrepancies.severity: medium - an implementer copying the sample would produce an invalid envelope

discrepancies.area: golden sample quality (not a structure rule)
discrepancies.observedInSample: These files contain "///" line comments (invalid JSON) and, in the Split/Tapered dosing files, a missing closing brace after the AllergyIntolerance reference. Entry order was recovered by textual scan instead.
discrepancies.resolution: Recorded as a data-quality note. Entry order for these files is reported under resourceTypeSequenceIncludingContained and INCLUDES contained Medication resources, so it is not a pure Bundle.entry list.
discrepancies.rule: Golden FHIR samples are expected to be valid JSON.

discrepancies.observedInSample: All three samples are MSH EVN PID PV1 [AL1...] [DG1] [PR1] - no PD1 and no PV2.
discrepancies.resolution: No conflict: PD1 and PV2 are Optional, so their absence is conformant. Recorded to confirm the optional segments must never be required by the validator.
discrepancies.rule: PD1 (O) and PV2 (O) are listed in the A01/A03/A08 structure.

discrepancies.corroboration: 2.16.840.1.113883.3.3731.1.210.100.7 is declared by page 15893106 'List of Surgeries Section (History of Procedures)' and is the oid used for List of Surgeries by every other CDA Body page (15859808, 15892634, 15925379, 15958062, 54723003). 100.87 is declared by page 16810590 'Immunization Serology Coded Results Section'.
discrepancies.goldenSample: spec-source/golden/CDA/On-demand documents as response/nphies Immunization Summary v4.9beta1 Full.xml
discrepancies.observedInSample: The List of Surgeries section carries 2.16.840.1.113883.3.3731.1.210.100.7, and 100.87 appears only once, on Immunization Serology Coded Results.
discrepancies.resolution: SAMPLE WINS. In an Immunization Summary the List of Surgeries section is ./component/section[templateId='2.16.840.1.113883.3.3731.1.210.100.7']. Row 1.6 on page 53477475 is a copy/paste defect.
discrepancies.rule: Page 53477475 gives the List of Surgeries section the templateId 2.16.840.1.113883.3.3731.1.210.100.87 - the SAME oid it gives row 1.10 'Immunization Serology Coded Results'.
discrepancies.severity: high - a validator built from the page alone would demand the wrong templateId

discrepancies.observedInSample: The sample order is ... Comparison/Previous Findings (204.28), Findings (204.30), Impressions (204.25), Addendum (204.36) - Findings comes BEFORE Impressions.
discrepancies.resolution: SAMPLE WINS on ordering: emit Findings before Impressions. Both sections are R2 [0..1] so neither is required; treat the order difference as a warning, not an error, until NPHIES clarifies whether section order is enforced here.
discrepancies.rule: Page 38895676 lists the sections in the order ... Comparison/Previous Findings (204.28), Impressions (204.25), Findings (204.30), Addendum (204.36).

discrepancies.observedInSample: The Max Rpt cell on page 68091912 reads "[1..*][JB1] [JB2]". "[JB1]" and "[JB2]" are leftover Word comment-reference markers from the source document, not cardinality.
discrepancies.resolution: The cardinality is [1..*]. The "[JB1] [JB2]" text is captured as a condition string so nothing is silently dropped, but it must not be treated as a rule.
discrepancies.rule: Max Rpt for "Bundle entry(s) for Laboratory Report - Service Request".

discrepancies.resolution: Take the Laboratory Order document templateId and type code FROM THE SAMPLE. Marked as sample-derived, not page-derived.
discrepancies.rule: The exported Confluence pages for Laboratory Orders give only the GENERIC "./templateId[1..*]" constraint (page 17629662); no page in the export states the Laboratory Order document templateId.
discrepancies.severity: medium - gap in the source export

scope.text:
The following describes the ORU HL7 v2 integration interface that is supported as part of the nphies solution. This feed is intended to provide vital signs captured within an encounter data feed to nphies and as such OBR-OBX group and PV1 segment are required. For the chapter on Observation Reporting (ORU) see: https://www.hl7.eu/HL7v2x/v25/std25/ch07.html#Heading1

workflowsText.text:
There are 4 transactional diagram/workflow for vital signs sharing.
Main workflow : a new Vital Sign Panel is created in the HIS
a. One to many Vital Sign Individual record(s) are created within one Vital Sign Panel
b. The Vital Sign Panel record created in an ORU is published to nphies
Exception 1: Amended Vital Sign Panel record/Vital Sign Individual record
Vital Sign Panel record has already been shared and an amendment is required
Amendment is added to the existing Vital Sign Panel (with the appropriate change in statuses i.e. OBR.25 is set to “C” and/or OBX.11 is set to “C” in the intended OBX(s)) and a new ORU is submitted to replace the original
Exception 2: Cancelled Vital Sign Panel record
Vital Sign Panel record has already been shared and a cancellation is required
Status change to cancelled is applied to the existing Vital Sign Panel (OBR.25 is set to “X” and OBX.11 is set to “D” or “W” in all OBXs) and a new ORU is submitted to cancel the original
Exception 3: Cancelled Vital Sign Individual record
Vital Sign Panel record has already been shared and a cancellation to a Vital Sign Individual record is required
Status change to cancelled is applied to the existing Vital Sign Individual record (OBX.11 is set to “D” or “W” in the intended OBX) and a new ORU is submitted to cancel the original

associations.prose:
In an ITI-41 Provide and Register transaction, SubmissionSets and DocumentEntries as well as DocumentEntries to DocumentEntries (e.g., in case of a RPLC or APPD association) are linked together by “Associations”.
The following shows an example of one DocumentEntry being part of a SubmissionSet;
<rim:RegistryObjectList>
<rim:RegistryPackage id="SubmissionSet01"> ... </rim:RegistryPackage>
<rim:Association id="Document01InSubmissionSet01" ... />
<rim:ExtrinsicObject id="Document01"> ... </rim:ExtrinsicObject>
</rim:RegistryObjectList>
The “associationType” attribute of an Association SHALL contain one of the following values:
The following shows an example of an Association between 2 DocumentEntries, where the new document identified by “sourceObject” replaces the document identified by “targetObject”;
<rim:Association
id=”urn:uuid:95e9115b-3d90-46ae-9610-ed34fd683d96”
status=”urn:oasis:names:tc:ebxml-regrep:StatusType:Approved”
associationType=”urn:ihe:iti:2007:AssociationType:RPLC”
sourceObject=”urn:uuid:3cce0135-cedb-4a26-ba00-8698ee8dde04”
targetObject=”urn:uuid:e0985823-dc50-45a5-a6c8-a11a829893bd”/>
Please refer to IHE ITI Technical Framework Volume 3, chapter 4.2 for a comprehensive description of the ebRIM representation used in an ITI-41 transaction (https://profiles.ihe.net/ITI/TF/Volume3/ch-4.2.html ).
Note: the concept of “Folders” is not used in nphies.
